newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-VIALBE OUTSPRINTS BELMONDO TO WIN SECOND GOLD.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-VIALBE OUTSPRINTS BELMONDO TO WIN SECOND GOLD.

text.p: Russian Yelena Vialbe narrowly outsprinted Italian Stefania Belmondo to win her second gold of the Nordic skiing world championships in Monday's 10-km freestyle pursuit cross-country race.
Vialbe, who had already beaten Belmondo into second place in Friday's opening 15-km freestyle race, crossed the line a few centimetres ahead of the Italian after a breathtaking duel.
Nina Gavrilyuk of Russia took third place 18.6 seconds behind, according to provisional results.

Vialbe and Belmondo, who started second and third respectively acording to their placings in Sunday's 5-km classical style race, soon caught Russian Lyubov Yegorova, the winner of the first part of the pursuit event.
